args.data: This note on the Signals tab highlights the importance of monitoring signal strength and signal decay. Signal decay measures how quickly the predictive power of a signal fades over time. A high signal value with rapid decay may require more frequent rebalancing, while a lower signal with slow decay can be held longer. The Signal Decay widget on this tab provides the decay profile for the Multi-Factor Alpha v4 model across the US Large Cap universe for the YTD period.
args.name: Signal & Decay Note
